memory_update.text: POWL should be carried forward as a high-priority underfollowed US-listed candidate for the dry-type transformer/power-quality node, despite being more switchgear and power-control than transformer pure-play.
BELFB/BELFA should be tracked as a second-order magnetics and power-conversion candidate; evidence is weaker and requires product-level data-center design-win validation.

PPSI is a speculative micro-cap exception with direct transformer/switchgear/mobile-power language but weak scale, backlog, and execution evidence; it should not survive later layers without hard contract proof.

For this node, switchgear, power-control rooms, electrical houses, magnetics, power supplies, and temporary/distributed power systems may be valid adjacent chokepoints when transformer lead times delay project energization.

Hammond Power Solutions appears to be the cleanest dry-type transformer reference point, but it is Canada-listed/OTC rather than a primary US exchange listing; later layers should decide whether OTC exposure is allowed.

node: Dry-type transformers and power-quality electrical equipment
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around dry-type transformers, power-quality equipment, and adjacent mission-critical electrical distribution. The strongest underfollowed mapping is not only transformer manufacturers, but also custom switchgear, power-control rooms, electrical protection/connection hardware, and smaller magnetics/power-conditioning suppliers that can become schedule gates for AI data centers, utilities, industrial electrification, renewables, LNG, and semiconductor facilities. Eaton remains the high-attention reference anchor; Powell, Bel Fuse, and Pioneer Power Solutions are underfollowed or shadow candidates requiring deeper evidence checks.
